errors.pagerRequired: Enter a pager number of 1 to 6 digits.

enrol.cedisHelp: Optional. Type a code or pick one from the list.
enrol.exclusionHelp: No QR or prompts. The patient stays on this board and the staff reassessment timer keeps running.
enrol.excludedHelp: Staff watch this patient directly. The staff reassessment timer is running and no patient prompts are sent.
enrol.qrHint: The patient or a companion scans this and says who they are. One phone at a time.
enrol.showAgain: The code works while the patient is waiting. You can show it again from the visit.

visit.title: Patient P-{{ref}}
visit.timersHelp: The patient check-in timer and the staff reassessment timer are separate. A patient answer never resets the staff timer.
visit.failed: This visit could not be loaded.
visit.stale: Could not refresh this visit. Showing the last available information.

answers.companionOnly: The patient did not answer this check-in.

actions.title: Actions
actions.noTask: There is no open task to acknowledge or assess.
actions.ackFirst: Acknowledge the task before you assess it.
actions.flagHelp: Raises a review task for the physician without changing the queue.
actions.stopAppHelp: Prompts stop and the signed-in phone is signed out. The staff reassessment timer keeps running. This cannot be undone.
actions.stopAppConfirm: I understand this cannot be undone.
actions.deviceHelp: One phone is signed in at a time. To switch people or phones, show the QR again.
actions.showQrFailed: The QR could not be shown.

errors.bpOrder: Diastolic must be lower than systolic.
errors.range: A value is outside the allowed range. Check for a typo.
errors.future: The measurement time cannot be in the future.

patient.departmentWait: AHS estimate right now: {{estimate}} from triage to seeing a doctor, for less urgent patients. It is not your personal wait.
patient.waitUnavailable: AHS wait estimate not available right now.
patient.placeInLine: The sickest people are seen first. Staff decide the order of care, not this app.
patient.title: You're signed in
patient.titleCompanion: You're answering for someone you're with
patient.reportChange: Tell us about a new symptom
patient.sendFailed: That did not send. Please try again, or tell a staff member.
patient.languageNotice: This translation is a draft. A medical translator has not checked it yet. If anything is unclear, ask a staff member.
patient.languageMissing: Questions are in English for now. Ask any staff member for an interpreter.
patient.signOutHelp: This phone will stop sending check-ins. You keep your place in line. To sign in again, scan the code.
patient.signOutFailed: This phone could not sign out. Try again.
patient.companionHint: Tell us what you see or hear. Only they can tell us how they feel inside.

leaving.title: Are you leaving?
leaving.info: Please tell a staff member before you go. If you feel worse, return to triage right away.
leaving.after: If you get worse after leaving, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department. For health advice any time, call 811.

sent.title: Thank you, we have your answers
sent.queuedBody: Not sent yet. We will keep trying. If you feel worse, tell a staff member.
sent.stillChecking: Staff will keep checking on you. If you feel worse, press "I need help now" or go to the triage desk.

message.clinician_will_check: A doctor or nurse will check on you.
message.clinician_told: We told a doctor or nurse.
message.leaving_info: Please tell staff before you leave. If you get worse after leaving, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department. For health advice any time, call 811.

outbox.saved: Not sent yet. We will keep trying. If you feel worse, tell a staff member now.

exchange.askDesk: Ask a staff member for a new code.
exchange.inactive: This code does not work anymore. Please ask a staff member for a new one.
exchange.failed: That did not work. Try again, or ask a staff member.

takeover.title: Another phone is already signed in
takeover.who: {{who}} signed in on another phone at {{time}}. Only one phone can be used. If you go on, that phone will be signed out.

signedOut.title: You've been signed out.
signedOut.help: If you need help now, tell a staff member. To sign in again, scan the visit's QR code.

exchange.intro: Use this page to tell ER staff if things change while you wait. It does not replace talking to staff.
exchange.help: Feeling much worse? Tell a staff member now.
exchange.companionHint: Family member or friend answering for them

privacy.title: What we store
privacy.stored1: Your answers and when you gave them.
privacy.stored2: How urgent the nurse rated your visit, and the main reason you came.
privacy.notStored: We never store your name or health number.
privacy.synthetic: This demo uses synthetic data only.
privacy.seen: ER staff see your answers. This is not your medical chart.
privacy.shared: Anyone holding this phone can see this page. Sign out before you lend it.

circle.title: Count the circles
circle.chooseCount: Tap − or + to choose a number.
circle.intro: You will see shapes appear one at a time. Count the circles. Ignore the squares.
circle.once: You only see them once. If you cannot do this, tap "I can't do this" and staff will check on you.
circle.watch: Watch the screen and count the circles.
circle.notTest: This is not a medical test. If it's hard, staff will simply come and check on you.

desk.title: Your question went to the triage nurse
desk.body: The triage nurse will get your question and come when they can. If you feel worse, go to the triage desk.
desk.notClinical: If you feel worse, press "I'm worried I'm getting worse". If you need help right away, press "I need help now" or go to the triage desk.

flow.finishLater: Stop and send what I've answered
flow.finishLaterHelp: If you stop, we send the answers you gave so far.
flow.chooseAnswer: Choose an answer, or choose "I'm not sure".

sessionEnd.app_excluded: the app is no longer offered

review.title: Physician worklist
review.stale: Update failed. Showing the list from {{time}}.

visitPage.boundaryRecord: Connect Care remains the clinical record.
visitPage.boundaryScope: Waiting-room companion · Not diagnosis or automatic re-triage
visitPage.flagLead: Raise a physician review task. Queue position and initial CTAS are unchanged.

overview.lead: Review the change, acknowledge the concern, then assess.
overview.queueUnchanged: Staff review needed. Queue position is unchanged.
overview.clockSafeguard: Patient answers do not reset the staff clock or clear this concern.
overview.nextStep: Next: record vitals and deliberately select an assessment disposition.

assessment.lead: Record the staff check. Acknowledgement and assessment are separate steps.
assessment.vitalsLead: Enter measured values; no values are prefilled.
assessment.measuredAtHelp: Leave empty to use the time you save.
assessment.vitalsNotAssessment: Saving vitals does not record the assessment.
assessment.recordReminder: Document clinical care in Connect Care.
assessment.recordReminderLead: Recheck supports waiting-room review, not the clinical record.
assessment.assessHelp: Disabled until acknowledged and a disposition is deliberately selected.

timeline.lead: Patient reports and task audit, with the evidence behind this concern.
timeline.safeguard: Patient responses never reset staff reassessment or clear an unresolved concern.

manage.lead: Visit details, app access and status. For clinical review or Flag higher, use Assessment.
manage.qrHelp: One reusable visit QR. After scanning, choose patient or companion; only one device can be signed in.
manage.qrReused: The same QR is reused for this visit.
manage.qrUnavailable: The visit QR is only available while the patient is waiting and the app is offered.
manage.statusHelp: Updating visit status is separate from completing the review task. Record an assessment in Assessment.
manage.stopImpact: Stops patient prompts and signs out the active device.
manage.stopCannotUndo: This cannot be undone. The app is currently offered.
manage.stopHelp: Disabled until a reason is selected and the irreversible change is confirmed.

triageInfo.title: How triage works
triageInfo.sickestFirst: The emergency department sees the sickest people first. It is not first come, first served.
triageInfo.levels: When each person arrives, a triage nurse checks how urgent their needs are. Canada uses 5 levels. Level 1 is the most urgent.
triageInfo.checkins: Check-in answers help staff notice changes. A clinician decides what happens next.
triageInfo.worse: If you feel worse, tell staff right away.
triageInfo.leaving: Please tell staff before you leave.

level.heading: Your triage level
level.label: Level {{level}}: {{name}}
level.setAtTriage: This is the level the triage nurse set on arrival.

2.name: Very urgent
2.body: The nurse found signs that need care very soon. Staff will check often.

3.name: Urgent
3.body: Care is needed soon, but it is not life-threatening right now. People who are sicker may be seen first.

4.name: Less urgent
4.body: This is not an emergency right now. The wait may be long. You are in the right place.

5.name: Not urgent
5.body: This can safely wait. The wait may be long. You are in the right place.

siteSettings.title: Patient screens
siteSettings.showLevelHelp: Applies to every patient at this site. When off, patients see only How triage works. Target times are never shown.
siteSettings.failed: That setting did not save. Try again.
